description: A Bot's conversation archived as a past thread of its own ("<Bot> / <its title>", read-only), and the Bot carried on in a new, empty one with a new agent (on another model if one's given): its id, name, picture, memory, tasks, browser and rules as they were. Refused while it's at a turn or one of its tasks is asking it.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

model.description: The model the Bot carries on on, of whatever program (null: its own). Given, a Bot with nothing said yet is moved onto it without a past thread.

effort.description: Its effort on model, if model's program has one (null: the Bot's own).
